headline: Chancellor announces £100 energy bill support
standfirst: The government's first budget aims to tackle the cost of living crisis.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Chancellor Healey announced a £100 payment for energy bills and a new tax on banks.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The move comes as the government tries to manage the ongoing cost of living crisis.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: Economic turmoil is hitting households hard. This budget is the government's first major response.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Critics argue the plan lacks boldness. Watch for upcoming debates on its effectiveness.

caption:
The UK government has unveiled a new budget featuring a £100 payment to help with energy bills.

Chancellor Healey is targeting the cost of living crisis with this new support package, funded in part by a bank tax. Opposition parties have already criticized the measures, arguing the government has not been bold enough to fix the current economic turmoil.
